records.title: Hezekiah and Sennacherib
records.posterAlt: Hezekiah prays over a letter before the sanctuary. An imagined scene.
records.description: Hezekiah lifts his head in prayer over the letter. This selects 2 Kings 19:14-19, not the full siege.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC
records.visualReview: The full-size two-second sample and 1fps sheet retain Hezekiah's mature brown face, defined brow and nose, dense dark natural curls and beard, strong build, teal mantle and circlet. Hands remain on the parchment; the lamp and sanctuary stay coherent. No extra Isaiah appears.

records.title: Hezekiah's Illness and the Babylonian Envoys
records.posterAlt: Hezekiah and Isaiah look at shadows on stone steps. An imagined scene.
records.description: Isaiah gestures toward the steps as Hezekiah watches. This selects the sign scene in 2 Kings 20:8-11, not the envoys.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC
records.visualReview: Full-size sample and 1fps sheet retain the same Hezekiah face, curls, beard and build as the prayer scene. Older Isaiah remains distinct, with gray curls, beard and brown mantle. The hand gesture and steps remain coherent. This short illustration does not establish a measured ten-step shadow reversal.

records.title: The Fall of Jerusalem
records.posterAlt: Families carry belongings away from Jerusalem. An imagined scene.
records.description: A family walks away from Jerusalem after its fall. This selects displacement in 2 Kings 25:8-12, without depicting violence.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC
records.visualReview: Full-size sample and 1fps sheet retain the anonymous family's brown faces, natural curls, clothing and ages. The infant remains securely wrapped and held. records.title: David's Last Charge and Death
records.posterAlt: Elderly David and Solomon hold rolled plans. An imagined scene.
records.description: David gives the plans to Solomon. This selects 1 Chronicles 28:11-12 rather than David's death or the completed temple.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC
records.visualReview: Full-size sample and 1fps sheet retain David's older brown face, lined skin, silver natural curls and gray beard, a plausible older version of earlier David.
